nodes.label: Editor scripts (custom inspectors, windows, menu items)
nodes.rationale: GameLoadContext must not keep its own assembly list because that kept the old collectible context alive (leak warning after each reload).
nodes.norm_label: editor scripts (custom inspectors, windows, menu items)

nodes.label: ShaderProgram.SetUint requirement
nodes.rationale: SetInt on a uint uniform is a GL error, value stays 0, and an indirect dispatch sized from it hangs the GPU.

nodes.label: VFX shared counter pool (CounterBuffer, 64 uint per system)
nodes.rationale: Layout is defined in three places that must stay in sync: VfxCodegen.Counter*, VFX_C_* in VfxCommon.glsl, C_* in VfxFrame.shader.
nodes.norm_label: vfx shared counter pool (counterbuffer, 64 uint per system)

nodes.label: VFX frame flow (VfxSimulationPass, VfxRuntime.RunSimulation)
nodes.rationale: All queued effects are packed into one uniform buffer and dispatched in phases with one barrier per phase to cut barriers.

nodes.label: Generated GLSL reserved word restrictions
nodes.rationale: Words like active, half, output, input, filter, sample, common, partition fail to compile on NVIDIA.

nodes.norm_label: vfx many-effects performance design and load test results

nodes.label: GameBuilder
nodes.rationale: Ships only what the build uses (BuildDependencies); assets baked to binary LELB, KTX, LELMODEL, .sdf so the player never needs Assimp or PNG decode.

nodes.label: Always Included Shaders (GraphicsSettings)
nodes.rationale: Shaders loaded by path from scripts were not followed by the build and the player crashed; user wanted the list in Project Settings > Graphics, not the Build tab.

nodes.label: AssimpModelBackend
nodes.rationale: FBX pivots folded and geometric transforms baked as Unity does; tangents from Mesh.WithTangents because Assimp's bitangents point along -v.

nodes.label: ScriptDomain (script build and load)
nodes.rationale: Source stamps (SHA-256 of every .cs) replace newest-time checks so deleted/renamed scripts rebuild; builds started before a script change are dropped, not killed (VBCSCompiler keeps writing).

nodes.label: Editor script components (stripped from builds)
nodes.rationale: User wanted editor-only generator components in the editor assembly with builds simply ignoring them; EditorScriptComponents.Strip removes them by assembly name.

nodes.label: LeakRoots (ClrMD GC root snapshot)
nodes.rationale: Managed tracer could not see thread stacks, GC handles; a process snapshot searched with ClrMD GCRoot finds the real roots.

nodes.label: LightBuffer (local lights UBO)
nodes.rationale: Static GI tracking held disabled lights and with them unloaded scenes; Forget on OnDisable/OnDestroy keeps static lists free of lights that are off.

nodes.label: EditorAutomation (C# automation API)
nodes.rationale: User wants AI to drive the editor natively: no MCP, no mouse simulation.

nodes.label: EditorActions (commands are actions, not UI)
nodes.rationale: A menu + click lost its question twice; user: 'it has to fire the ACTION, not the menu'. Actions never ask; they throw InvalidOperationException when the user's word is needed.

nodes.label: EditorGui wrappers and TestAnchors (UI elements)
nodes.rationale: Elements named as the inspector shows them (kind:path) so automation can click/input without the mouse; new editor code must use EditorGui, not raw ImGui.

nodes.label: Editor start: windows first, project over frames
nodes.rationale: User asked the real windows to show first, empty, with heavy loading after; stand-in windows were rejected.
nodes.norm_label: editor start: windows first, project over frames

nodes.label: FramePacing (median, vsync-snapped deltaTime)
nodes.rationale: Stutter came from deltaTime measuring CPU noise; median of 8 presents snapped to refresh periods; per-interval snapping failed on a remote-desktop display.

nodes.label: Super sampling anti-aliasing (SuperSamplingSettings)
nodes.rationale: Designed around NVIDIA DSR/DLDSR factors; filters after the tonemap so bright edges are anti-aliased; soft lighting keeps window density so cost does not grow.

nodes.label: Parallel shader compile and immutable textures
nodes.norm_label: parallel shader compile and immutable textures

nodes.label: NullCheckWeaver (Mono.Cecil)
nodes.rationale: Gives destroyed objects Unity's == null semantics; forward stack-kind analysis because Release IL keeps values on the stack across statements; editor scripts woven too by user's choice.

nodes.label: ShaderCompilation (game-controlled compile)
nodes.rationale: Splash compiled every variant; user wanted only the first scene's variants there and the game's logic to start the rest.

nodes.label: ShaderCompileHelper (separate process)
nodes.rationale: AMD's driver holds every context of a process while one compiles, so a second process keeps the menu smooth.

nodes.label: GrabPass refraction (SceneGrab)
nodes.rationale: Per-object grab chosen over one copy before transparents so glass sees glass and particles behind it; depth mask keeps foreground from being pulled in.

nodes.label: DistanceFieldAtlas (mesh SDF atlas)
nodes.rationale: Fields keyed by shape; shape changes settle 0.25 s before building, unused fields evicted, atlas grows to avoid per-frame fields filling it.

nodes.label: Exact sRGB display transfer
nodes.rationale: x^(1/2.2) lifted deep shadows by up to 9/255 against Unity.

nodes.label: Second UV set, textures past 8, lelTime
nodes.norm_label: second uv set, textures past 8, leltime

nodes.label: LODGroup
nodes.rationale: GI always uses level 0 (as Unity) so switching levels does not force GI recapture.

nodes.label: ImpostorBaker
nodes.rationale: Each view drawn twice (depth, then EQUAL with blend MAX) so coplanar faces resolve identically and bakes are byte-identical; Shape atlas ships uncompressed because BC7 ragged the outlines.

nodes.label: Material shader's own passes (ShadowCaster/GeometryPrepass Custom, SurfaceCapture)
nodes.norm_label: material shader's own passes (shadowcaster/geometryprepass custom, surfacecapture)

nodes.label: Deterministic documents (JsonDocumentWriter)
nodes.rationale: Saves produced empty diffs across machines; LF newlines, sorted $types and dictionary keys, fields in MetadataToken order.

nodes.label: AssetThumbnails (cached 32x32)
nodes.rationale: Pinging a texture loaded a 19 GB folder to the GPU and took the editor down; lists never load textures for icons.

nodes.label: Automated runs never write user state files
nodes.rationale: A test once moved the user's real console and camera; layout.ini, EditorState.json, windows.json are read-only for automated runs.
nodes.norm_label: automated runs never write user state files

nodes.label: GI method fixed while running; only active GI allocates
nodes.norm_label: gi method fixed while running; only active gi allocates

nodes.label: VoxelGIPass (voxel cone tracing)
nodes.rationale: Relit from scratch each frame, no history; smoothness from world-anchored cone jitter and a-trous filtering.

nodes.label: SceneViewPanel navigation
nodes.rationale: Navigation depth taken fresh under the cursor (mesh, cloud, SceneDepthProbe, grid median, nearest box); never capture the cursor (Chrome Remote Desktop injects absolute positions).

nodes.label: GI volume follow-camera and toroidal scrolling
nodes.norm_label: gi volume follow-camera and toroidal scrolling

nodes.label: ImGui assert discipline (balanced Push/Pop, Begin/EndChild)
nodes.rationale: Asserts are on in the editor's own panels; an unbalanced pop or a return between BeginChild/EndChild aborts the process.

nodes.label: VFX counter layout (defined three times)
nodes.rationale: VfxCodegen.Counter*, VFX_C_* in VfxCommon.glsl and C_* in VfxFrame.shader must stay in sync.

nodes.label: Volumetric objects (VolumetricObjectBase)
nodes.rationale: User direction: general, physically consistent, tunable features before matching New Frontier's Unity look.

nodes.label: Volumetric temporal filter with distance-checked history
nodes.norm_label: volumetric temporal filter with distance-checked history

nodes.label: Light.VolumeMode (Live / Baked / Dynamic)
nodes.rationale: User's rule: never let the engine decide; a short flash joining baked lights reworked all 22 and hitched combat. Dynamic lights integrated exactly in the march to avoid ghosting and noise.

nodes.label: Volumetric media volume (clouds in the GI)
nodes.rationale: Six-sided looks and column-built coverage instead of box filtering, which turned small thick clouds into wide solid ones (13x light).
nodes.norm_label: volumetric media volume (clouds in the gi)

nodes.label: CameraShake
nodes.rationale: User: a separate component working on the transform, no render-time state, so there are no inconsistencies; rest pose restored exactly.

nodes.label: Timeline (Unity Timeline with Audio Studio logic)
nodes.rationale: User: plain editor panel, no FMOD deck or snapshots; only keyed properties overridden during playback.
nodes.norm_label: timeline (unity timeline with audio studio logic)

nodes.label: UI Toolkit runtime additions (Painter2D, SVG, render textures)
nodes.norm_label: ui toolkit runtime additions (painter2d, svg, render textures)

nodes.label: UI text distance field range (SdfSpread 24, R16 atlas)
nodes.rationale: Small text shadows showed glyph quads as boxes because the field knew only 8 atlas pixels; wider range and clamping fix it.
nodes.norm_label: ui text distance field range (sdfspread 24, r16 atlas)

nodes.label: Game effects belong in the game repo, not the engine
nodes.rationale: User's correction 2026-10-31: the engine keeps only general features a game needs.
nodes.norm_label: game effects belong in the game repo, not the engine

nodes.label: When things are written (scene on Save, the rest as it changes)
nodes.rationale: User's rule: assets/settings written on change with undo as the way back; exceptions are heavy imports and tools with own windows (VFX Graph, Audio Studio, UI Builder).
nodes.norm_label: when things are written (scene on save, the rest as it changes)

nodes.label: Imports paused while editor is in background (Auto Refresh)
nodes.rationale: Reverting files one by one imported each step (half-reverted builds, scene merges); automation imports when a command comes so an agent's edits build once.
nodes.norm_label: imports paused while editor is in background (auto refresh)

nodes.label: LELEngine (C# game engine, Unity-like workflow)
nodes.rationale: Unity-like workflow on .NET 10, OpenTK 4.9 and OpenGL 4.6 (4.3 minimum), developed and tuned on an Intel integrated GPU; editor drivable from code and CLI, builds headless on Windows and Linux.

nodes.label: Document model: JSON in editor, LELB binary in builds
nodes.rationale: One document model, two encodings; conversion needs no types loaded so a build never runs game code.
nodes.norm_label: document model: json in editor, lelb binary in builds

nodes.label: SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync
nodes.rationale: Document and assets read on a loading thread, textures decode on worker threads, shaders compile together, GPU uploads spread over frames.

nodes.label: Animation (AnimationClip, Animator, AnimatorController)
nodes.rationale: Animators of a scene evaluate in parallel on worker threads; poses and callbacks applied in scene order.

nodes.label: Timeline (.timeline assets with logic track)
nodes.rationale: Unity's Timeline with the logic of an audio tool: loop/transition regions, markers, parameters.

nodes.rationale: Builds ship imported data so the player has no importer.
nodes.norm_label: model import (assimp via silk.net, obj reader, model asset)

nodes.label: 2D physics (Box2D v3 via Box2D.NET)
nodes.rationale: XY or XZ plane per project setting, same API and results in both.

nodes.norm_label: pass-based renderer (hdr, depth prepass, cascaded shadows, gpu-driven)

nodes.label: Shader variants (automatic shader_feature, glslang build check)
nodes.rationale: glslang gives the same verdict on every machine with no GPU; a variant that fails stops the build.
nodes.norm_label: shader variants (automatic shader_feature, glslang build check)

nodes.label: Program binary cache (glGetProgramBinary)
nodes.rationale: Later starts compile nothing: shader step 6 s -> 83 ms.

nodes.label: GrabPass refraction
nodes.rationale: Copy carries the depth so objects in front are never pulled into the refraction; only read rectangles copied.

nodes.label: LODGroup
nodes.rationale: The GI always sees the first level.

nodes.label: Impostor (octahedral baked billboards)
nodes.rationale: 3,600 ships 24.8 ms as meshes vs 6.6 ms as impostors on an integrated GPU; lit by scene lights and GI, casts/receives shadows.

nodes.label: Shader-drawn depth passes (ShadowCaster Custom, GeometryPrepass Custom, SurfaceCapture)
nodes.norm_label: shader-drawn depth passes (shadowcaster custom, geometryprepass custom, surfacecapture)

nodes.label: Input system (Rewired-style, LELEngine.InputSystem)
nodes.rationale: Game reads actions of a player, never keys.

nodes.label: GPU particles (VFX Graph-style, LELEngine.VFX)
nodes.rationale: Built for many effects: batched dispatches, no per-particle atomics, culled idle systems; 402 effects ~1M particles 39 fps -> 820 fps.

nodes.label: SceneMerge (three-way merge of scene documents)
nodes.rationale: The open scene follows its file when git or a text editor changes it; only conflicting values ask.

nodes.norm_label: hot reload of files changed outside the editor

nodes.label: Saving policy (scene on Ctrl+S, settings written immediately)
nodes.rationale: What would hang on a change or has its own window waits for its own action (Apply / Save).

nodes.label: Background script compilation and domain reload
nodes.norm_label: background script compilation and domain reload

nodes.label: LELEngine.Editor.Graphs.GraphView
nodes.rationale: Immediate-mode node graph: nodes and edges declared from your data every frame, changes applied via callbacks; the system behind the Animator window.

nodes.label: Unit tests (Game.Tests.dll, LELEngine.Testing)
nodes.rationale: Tests run in the editor's main thread in edit mode within a frame budget so the editor stays responsive; never reach a player build.

nodes.label: Smooth motion frame pacing
nodes.rationale: Game advances by the even time between presented frames, not the noisy last-frame time.

nodes.label: Game build (Build tab, batch mode, splash screen)
nodes.norm_label: game build (build tab, batch mode, splash screen)

nodes.label: Destroying objects (Destroy, ObjectDestroyedException)
nodes.rationale: Killed at once for the game, finished at end of frame; destroying twice does nothing.

nodes.label: NullCheckWeaver
nodes.rationale: Rewrites compiled game scripts so every null check (?., ??, is null, interfaces) treats destroyed objects as null, unlike Unity where only == does.
